record.original_question: In the special case where T1, ..., Tℓ are weak mixing and p1, ..., pℓ are pairwise independent integer polynomials, must the averages (1/N) Σ T1^{p1(n)} f1 · ... · Tℓ^{pℓ(n)} fℓ converge in L2(µ) to the product of the integrals ∫f1 dµ · ... · ∫fℓ dµ?

evidence.quote: Special Case of Problem 15. Suppose that all the transformations T1, . . . , Tℓ : X → X are weak mixing and the polynomials p1, . . . , pℓ ∈ Z[t] are pairwise independent. Show that lim 1/N Σ T1^p1(n) f1 · · · Tℓ^pℓ(n) fℓ = ∫ f1 dµ · · · ∫ fℓ dµ.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu)$ be a probability space and let $T_1,\ldots,T_\ell\colon X\to X$ be commuting invertible measure-preserving transformations. Recall that a measure-preserving transformation $T$ on $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu)$ is called weakly mixing if for every $f,g\in L^2(\mu)$,
$$\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}\Big|\int (f\circ T^n)\,g\,d\mu-\int f\,d\mu\int g\,d\mu\Big|=0.$$
A family of polynomials $p_1,\ldots,p_\ell\in\mathbb{Z}[t]$ is called pairwise independent if $p_i$ and $p_i-p_j$ are non-constant for all $i\neq j$.

Assume that each $T_i$ is weakly mixing and that $p_1,\ldots,p_\ell\in\mathbb{Z}[t]$ are pairwise independent. Prove or disprove: for all $f_1,\ldots,f_\ell\in L^\infty(\mu)$,
$$\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}\big(T_1^{p_1(n)}f_1\big)\cdots\big(T_\ell^{p_\ell(n)}f_\ell\big)=\int f_1\,d\mu\,\cdots\,\int f_\ell\,d\mu$$
in $L^2(\mu)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work of Frantzikinakis and Kuca (Inventiones Math., 2024; arXiv:2207.12288) on joint ergodicity for commuting transformations gives necessary and sufficient conditions for joint ergodicity along pairwise independent polynomial iterates and, combined with seminorm-control results, settles this case: for commuting weakly mixing transformations and pairwise independent integer polynomials, the multiple polynomial average converges in $L^2$ to the product of the integrals.

status_evidence.title: Joint ergodicity for commuting transformations and applications to polynomial sequences
status_evidence.snippet: Necessary and sufficient conditions for joint ergodicity of collections of sequences with respect to systems of commuting measure-preserving transformations; settles several conjectures including those for pairwise independent polynomial iterates.
status_evidence.claim: Frantzikinakis–Kuca establish joint ergodicity (convergence to the product of integrals) for commuting weakly mixing transformations along pairwise independent integer polynomials.

status_evidence.title: Seminorm control for ergodic averages with commuting transformations along pairwise dependent polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Multiple ergodic averages of commuting transformations are controlled by Host-Kra seminorms; under mild ergodicity assumptions averages converge to the product of integrals for pairwise independent polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: The Host-Kra factor is characteristic and convergence to the product of integrals holds in the pairwise independent polynomial setting with weak mixing.
